evals.name: spec-driven-rewrite-simple
evals.prompt: I want to do a cleanroom rewrite of the Python project at /home/minder/projekty/oh-my-slop/ (just the scripts/ directory — a markdown reference validator and related tooling). Write the Phase 1 behavioral specification to SPEC.md. My threat model is code quality and maintainability — I want a cleaner, better-tested rewrite.
evals.expected_output: A behavioral specification with no code snippets, confidence tags ([VERIFIED]/[INFERRED]/[UNKNOWN]), and all required sections (Overview, External Interfaces, Functional Behavior, Data Structures, Business Rules, Edge Cases, Non-Functional, Philosophy of Implementation, Gap Inventory).

evals.name: impl-from-spec
evals.prompt: Here is a specification document (path: /home/minder/projekty/oh-my-slop/SPEC.md). Implement a working Python script based strictly on this spec. You have NOT seen the original codebase. Record all assumptions and gap resolutions in ASSUMPTIONS.md.
evals.expected_output: Working code that satisfies the spec, plus an ASSUMPTIONS.md log for all gap resolutions and assumptions.

evals.name: verification-protocol
evals.prompt: I have the original scripts/ at /home/minder/projekty/oh-my-slop/scripts/ and a rewrite at /home/minder/projekty/rewrite-app/scripts/. Produce a verification plan with characterization tests and a divergence report.
evals.expected_output: Three-phase verification: spec conformance tests, characterization comparison with PASS/SPEC_ERROR/IMPL_DEVIATION/UNKNOWN_ZONE classification, and property-based invariants.
